cues.en: -: In some sense, the past was a simpler time.
cues.zh: 某種程度而言，過去是比較單純的時代。

cues.en: Politics was more local, men could wear goatees without being laughed at, and the word "Data" was universally recognized
cues.zh: 政治比較地方化，男人留山羊鬍不會被笑，而且 Data 這個詞，大家都認為，

cues.en: Data meant multiple data points, like more than one.
cues.zh: Data 代表多個資料點，也就是不只一個。

cues.en: A single piece of data, one individual data point, was called a datum.
cues.zh: 單一資料、一個個別資料點，叫做 datum。

cues.en: You could also say, "One data point", or "One data value", or, "One piece of data", but the word data on its own was plural.
cues.zh: 也可以說 one data point、one data value，或 one piece of data，但 data 本身是複數。

cues.en: Therefore, if you were to say something like, "This data shows", then people would just think you didn't speak English very well.
cues.zh: 所以如果說 This data shows，人們只會覺得你的英文不太好。

cues.en: You could say, "This data point shows", or "This datum shows", but to refer to multiple data points, you would use, "These data show".
cues.zh: 可以說 This data point shows，或 This datum shows，但要指多個資料點，應該用 These data show。

cues.en: Now, there's been a trend in the past, I don't know, decade or something, to abuse the English language and to allow such a barbarism as,
cues.zh: 不過，過去大概十年，有種濫用英文的趨勢，容許這種野蠻的說法，

cues.en: "This data show", or "Data is", you know, there's a whole Reddit subpage that's called, "Data is Beautiful".
cues.zh: This data show，或 Data is。Reddit 甚至有個叫做 Data is Beautiful 的版面。

cues.en: Ah, it just, it grates on my ears, it sounds like a hundred year old witch just scratching her overgrown fingernails down a chalkboard.
cues.zh: 啊，聽起來真刺耳，就像百歲老巫婆，用過長的指甲刮黑板。

cues.en: It's really a pet peeve of mine.
cues.zh: 這真是我特別受不了的事。

cues.en: So in this course, I will use datum as singular and data as plural, and I will use correct English grammatical tenses
cues.zh: 所以這門課，我會用 datum 表示單數，data 表示複數，並使用正確的英文文法時態，

cues.en: and make sure that my subjects and verbs match in numerosity as much as possible.
cues.zh: 盡量確保主詞與動詞在單複數上一致。

cues.en: although, of course, I'm sure I make a mistake every now and then.
cues.zh: 當然，我相信自己偶爾還是會犯錯。

cues.en: All right, enough ranting, let's get to the real issues.
cues.zh: 好，抱怨夠了，開始真正的主題。
